content: Fii Kisiyee Mawɗo on
Ko ɗun waɗi, hiɗen haani cataade fota e ko nanuɗen kon, fii wota en selu.
Ko fii, si konguɗi ɗi malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen hewtini maamiraaɓe men ɓen ɗin haqinqinaama, awa kadi kala bonnere e noone geddi yoɓiraama ko handi kon,
haray ko honno daɗiroyten si en wedditike e sifa oo kisiyee mawɗo? Ko Joomi men on tigi adii feɲɲinde mo, onsay non nanunooɓe mo ɓen haqinqinani en.
Allaahu on seeditodi e maɓɓe, o ɓanginiri ɗun kuuɗe e maandeeji e noone kaawakeeji moƴƴi e sendirgol dokke *Ruuhu Seniiɗo on wano o yiɗiri non.
Fii Ardotooɗo Yimɓe ɓen ka Kisiyee
Hinaa malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen Alla yankinani oo aduna aroyoowo mo wowleten fii mun on.
Kono goɗɗo no seeditii nokku goo, wi'i:

content.text: «Ko honɗun woni neɗɗo fii no anditiraa fii makko, yaa an Alla,
e ko woni ɓii neɗɗanke fii yo a danko mo?

content: A waɗii mo e ley malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen e nder seeɗa nii,

content.text: a taaranii mo *meetelol mangu e teddungal,
a waɗii mo e hoore kuuɗe juuɗe maa ɗen,
a waɗii piiji ɗin fow e ley koyɗe makko.»

content: E nder yankinangol mo piiji ɗin fow, alaa ko Alla acci yo ronku yankinanaade mo, kono haa jooni en yi'aali ka piiji ɗin fow yankinanii mo.

Kono non e hino ko tawɗen kon: ɓawto o waɗeede e ley malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen fii saa'ihun nii, kanko Iisaa o waɗanaama meetelol mangu e teddungal sabu mayde nde o tampiri nden, fii, tippude e moƴƴere Alla nden, yo o maayan yimɓe ɓen fow.
E dow ardagol fayɓe buy ka mangu, tawi no hawrani on Taguɗo piiji fow, e mo piiji ɗin fow wonani on, laatinirgol Iisaa timmuɗo e nder tampereeji, on Sincuɗo kisiyee maɓɓe on.
Ko fii, ko *laɓɓinɗo on e *laɓɓinaaɓe ɓen fow woni iwdi wootiri. Ko ɗun waɗi kanko Iisaa o hersiraa noddirgol ɓe musiɓɓe,
wano o wi'iri Alla non wonde:

content.text: «Mi jantanto musiɓɓe an ɓen innde maa nden,

content: O wi'i kadi:

content.text: «Mi waɗay hoolaare an nden e makko.»

content: Awa kadi:

content.text: «E hino lan, min e fayɓe ɓe Alla okkimmi ɓen.»

content: Awa nde tawnoo fayɓe ɓen no mari ƴiiƴan e ɓandu, kanko Iisaa kadi ko wano non o tawdiraa e maɓɓe, fii, rewrude e mayde makko nden, yo o muncu on joginooɗo bawgal mayde nden, ɗun ko Ibuliisa,
e fii yo o jattin kala wonnooɓe e nder maccangaaku e nder ngurndan mun sabu kulol mayde.
Ɓay, pellet wonaa malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen o ari faabagol, kono ko jurriya Ibraahiima on o ari faabagol.
Ko ɗun waɗi si himo haanunoo nandude e musiɓɓe makko ɓen few, fii no o wonira *yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka ka Alla, yurmeteeɗo, holniiɗo e nder golle Alla ɗen, fii no jamaa on heɓira yaafuyee junuubaaji.
Ɓay kanko tigi o tampii fewndo o ndarndaa, himo waawi faabaade wonaaɓe e ndarndeede ɓen.
